name: Account hijacked or access lost
description: Users report their accounts being hacked, altered, or locked out after losing access to recovery methods.

name: Vague app access and connectivity failures
description: Users find the app unopenable, locked out, or falsely reporting no internet connection without a clear cause.

name: Cannot log in via phone or Facebook
description: Users are unable to sign in with their phone number or Facebook, getting errors or crashes at login.

name: Password rejected and forced resets
description: Users say correct passwords are rejected, forcing repeated resets or unexpected logouts.

name: Account creation errors on signup
description: New users get generic errors or blocks when trying to create or connect an account.

name: Payment rejections and paid premium issues
description: Users feel pressured to pay and report failed payments or paying without getting the promised benefits.

name: Frustration with paywalled features generally
description: Users are annoyed that many basic features and downloads require paying for premium.

name: Basic features locked behind premium
description: Free users face skip limits and restricted controls, and some premium users still find features missing.

name: Ads and cost outweigh value
description: Users feel the price is too high and that ads persist even when paying for ad-free time.

name: Forced subscription and family plan limits
description: Users feel pushed to subscribe and find family plan sharing too restrictive.

name: Unwanted songs and missing liked songs
description: Users cannot play the songs they choose, get unwanted tracks added, and find liked songs display blank.

name: Lyrics missing or unavailable
description: Users report lyrics fail to load or show only partially, even for premium subscribers.

name: Artists and labels missing from catalog
description: Users find favorite songs, labels, or artists have been removed or are unavailable.

name: Podcast features missing or broken
description: Users report podcasts fail to load, cannot cast, or lost sections like "What's new".

name: Unwanted algorithmic suggestions and repeats
description: Users are annoyed by suggested songs inserted into playlists and shuffle that ignores their choices.

name: Search returns wrong or no results
description: Users searching for specific songs get unrelated tracks or playlists instead.

name: Downloads fail or require premium
description: Users cannot download music or playlists, or find auto-download unreliable.

name: Downloaded songs vanish or grey out
description: Users find downloaded songs and queues disappear, grey out, or need repeated redownloading.

name: Liked songs and history vanish
description: Users lose liked songs, search history, and playlist items, and find content not showing.

name: Offline mode fails without internet
description: Users cannot play music offline, and the app stalls or won't load without a connection.

name: General dissatisfaction with the app
description: Users express broad negative opinions about the app without naming a specific problem.

name: Low audio quality and volume
description: Users find sound quality weak, bass low, volume quiet, and lack high-fidelity options.

name: Heavy battery and storage drain
description: Users report the app drains battery in the background and uses excessive storage.

name: Playback drops and device connection issues
description: Music stops, sticks, or fails to play in background or on Wi-Fi, and devices connect unexpectedly.

name: App crashes or fails to open
description: Users report the app crashes mid-song, freezes, or won't start at all.

name: Frequent bugs during playback
description: Users report repeated glitches, songs playing wrong, and playback that no longer works after updates.

name: Slow loading and laggy performance
description: Users see the app stuck on loading screens or lagging, especially on older devices.

name: Music stops unexpectedly
description: Playback halts randomly, especially when switching apps, forcing users to restart.

name: Poor customer support responses
description: Users feel support is unhelpful, chatbots block them, and premium complaints are ignored.

name: Too many unskippable ads
description: Users are frustrated by frequent, long, unskippable ads between songs.

name: Ads and restrictive shuffle-only playback
description: Users complain about ads and being unable to choose songs or control playback order.

name: Playlists reorder and songs added unexpectedly
description: Users cannot play playlists in order, playlist links fail, and unwanted songs get added.

name: Shuffle forced, controls removed
description: Users cannot turn off shuffle, skip freely, or choose the starting song after updates removed controls.

name: Unwanted homepage and layout changes
description: Users dislike the redesigned home screen, removed history, and podcasts being pushed forward.
